newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi board member Morris wants to leave.
newsitem.headline: Audi board member Morris wants to leave.

text.p: Graham Morris, board member of German car-maker Audi AG responsible for marketing and distribution, has asked the Audi supervisory board to be relieved of his position, Audi said on Wednesday.
Audi said in a statment that Morris has been with Audi for a year-and-a-half and said he was leaving for family reasons, adding that he wanted to return to Britain.

He moved to Audi In April 1995, previous to which he worked for Rover Europe. Morris is married with four children. His family stayed behind when he moved to Germany. The Audi supervisory board will deal with his request on December 4.
